# Choreo Planer — Developers & Agents

> Scoped index for developers and AI agents integrating with Choreo Planer.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://www.choreo-planer.de/agents.md): When to use Choreo Planer and how to call it.
- [Full agent guide](https://www.choreo-planer.de/llms-full.txt): The complete long-form agent guide.
- [Authentication guide](https://api.choreo-planer.de/auth.md): Obtain and send a JWT bearer token.

## Discovery documents

- [Agent card (A2A)](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/agent-card.json): Capabilities, skills and contact endpoint.
- [Agent skills index](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Skills catalog backed by the REST API and MCP server.
- [MCP server card](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): MCP identity, transport and tool previews.
- [ard.json](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery manifest.
- [ai-catalog.json](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): AI Catalog discovery alias.
- [ai-plugin.json](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): ChatGPT / plugin manifest.
- [skills.sh](https://www.choreo-planer.de/skills.sh): One-line bootstrap printing the connection details.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/andreasnicklaus/cheer-choreo-tool): Source and `AGENTS.md` coding-agent instructions.
